instruction:
You are working on the exact public desktop-ui-cv baseline recorded in source_manifest.json.

Repair only the two dataset-integrity defects described below and add focused regression tests in tests/test_dataset_integrity.py.

F-09 validation integrity:
- src/desktop_ui_cv/dataset/generator.py must never silently use training images as validation data.
- when split is "train" or "all" and an independent val/images directory is absent, generate_dataset must fail closed with ValueError and must not write a misleading data.yaml.
- when val/images exists, data.yaml must use val: val/images and must not alias val to the train path.

F-10 OCR coordinate integrity:
- whenever render_w/render_h differ from the final 1280x720 training image, every bbox in page.ground_truth_texts must receive the same scale_x/scale_y transform as page.elements before OCR ground truth is emitted.
- preserve integer bbox coordinates and existing text/metadata.

Also add tests/test_dataset_integrity.py covering both defects. Preserve deterministic seeded generation and existing in-bounds YOLO-label behavior. Inspect scripts/retrain_yolo26s.py and scripts/train_fold.py as read-only context; do not modify them. Do not redesign the generator, training architecture, or model code.
